usedFor: Kitchen.co holds clients and invoices, and Google Docs gets text via “Add or Replace Text In Tab” after “Invoice Paid”.

bestTemplate.name: “Invoice Paid” in Kitchen.co, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: A paid invoice writes new text into a chosen Google Doc tab, or replaces that tab's existing content.

watchOut: “Add or Replace Text In Tab” can replace a tab’s content, so confirm you chose add before “Card Updated”.
